title: American Height Rose While 36 Countries Passed It
hook: American men grew taller while their height lead disappeared.
closing: Height can improve at home while faster gains elsewhere erase a country's advantage.
question: Are you taller than your grandparents?

segments.say: American men's average height reached 177 centimeters, but the gain did not preserve their global lead.
South Korean women gained 20.2 centimeters, showing how much faster height rose elsewhere.
By 2014, 36 countries had taller average men than the US, turning growth into a ranking collapse.
